dataflow.title: SPAD/CAL async source select
dataflow.claim: mptdc_input_mux selects SPAD or calibration START/STOP as pure combinational async signals.

dataflow.title: START accepts and allocates a context
dataflow.claim: The frontend accepts START only when armed, unlatched, and with a free context; it then latches active_ctx.

dataflow.title: STOP launches fast oscillator and PD eligibility
dataflow.claim: STOP or synthetic timeout sets stop_latched only after START; fast oscillator and PD enable derive from START/STOP latches.

dataflow.title: 8 x 8 phase detector matrix
dataflow.claim: mptdc_core generates one PD cell per slow/fast phase pair and latches per-cell nfast_hit.

dataflow.title: Snapshot, context bank, drain
dataflow.claim: clk_sys measurement control samples the held image, commits context, then drain_ctrl emits META/HIT records.

dataflow.title: FIFO to local or shared readout
